text:
- New Notes tab: keep codes, addresses and lists in one place, with labels, colors and search.
- Chats feel like you expect: swipe a chat for Read, Pin, Mute and Delete; press and hold a message for reactions and a full menu.
- New: unread counts, Unread and Groups filters, archive chats, star messages, message info, delete for me, last seen and online.
- Smart tasks: "by Friday" sets the due date, the person you @mention gets the task, and tasks can repeat every day, week or month.
- The keyboard stays up when you record a voice note or tap plus.
- Many fixes and speed improvements.
